answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 4864 Country: India Title: Is it permissible for my husband to caress my sex with his fingers until I reach orgasm. Do I need to make ghusl after this, even there was no intercourse? Question: Is it permissible for my husband to caress my sex with his fingers until I reach orgasm. Do I need to make ghusl after this, even there was no intercourse? Answer ID: 4864 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 649/614=L/1429) Yes, it is allowed. If you ejaculate then ghusl is compulsory, otherwise not. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
